summary: Capsule is a CLI tool that bundles a web app together with an embedded SQLite database into a single distributable file. It runs locally via Python, offering both command‑line and terminal UI modes without requiring any external API keys. Developers who need portable, zero‑install web apps for quick demos or offline usage will find it useful, especially because it handles data storage out of the box. The main strength is its convenience and single‑file distribution, while the limited test coverage (2/5 passed) and early‑stage maturity (v0.2.1) are notable drawbacks.
